note: Shrink-only allowance for the DATA-SHAPE literals: object-literal copy properties (`object-literal:<key>`) and JSX child expressions (`jsx-child-expression`) under src/renderer. Each id is `<shape> | <exact text>`, sorted, and both halves are the identity — the text is part of it so a finding cannot be swapped for a different one of the same shape and still fit. scripts/i18n/check-strings.mjs FAILS on any data-shape finding NOT listed here (a new literal, or a replacement of a listed one) and on any listed id that is no longer found (the allowance can only shrink; `--prune-allowance` removes the paid-off ids and never adds). The baseline (i18n/baseline.json) is untouched: the data shapes are governed HERE, not by a per-file ceiling, so this debt has one owner, one payoff and one place to pay it. A new id is a reviewed decision with a named owner and a real payoff, never a check-fix; `--allowance-base <ref>` refuses growth relative to the base branch. See docs/i18n/literal-allowance.md.
